tokens.name: cream-100
tokens.usage: Page ground — warm poster paper (Night: the sky over the Seine / the Thames).

tokens.name: cream-50
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, answer options, inputs.

tokens.name: cream-200
tokens.usage: Wells, hover on cream-50, empty progress track, hint box.

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: Ground behind every illustration — stays cream at night, like a printed card on a dark table.

tokens.name: rule-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet dividers inside a card. Never for control borders (those use pen).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on cream-100 / cream-50. Navy, so it sits with both pens.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: instructions, captions, metadata.

tokens.name: fr-pen
tokens.usage: French course pen — cobalt, like a Paris street plaque. Line art, borders, buttons, the display word.

tokens.name: fr-pen-strong
tokens.usage: French hover / pressed; text on fr-tint.

tokens.name: fr-tint
tokens.usage: French tint: the Seine, selected answer, filled states.

tokens.name: fr-shadow
tokens.usage: French print-offset shadow (dimmer at night).

tokens.name: en-pen
tokens.usage: English course pen — postbox red, like a London bus. Line art, borders, buttons, the display word.

tokens.name: en-pen-strong
tokens.usage: English hover / pressed; text on en-tint.

tokens.name: en-tint
tokens.usage: English tint: the Thames, selected answer, filled states.

tokens.name: en-shadow
tokens.usage: English print-offset shadow (dimmer at night).

tokens.name: house-pen
tokens.usage: Pen for screens before a course is picked (login, step 1, teacher area): navy ink.

tokens.name: house-tint
tokens.usage: Tint for house screens.

tokens.name: house-shadow
tokens.usage: Shadow for house screens.

tokens.name: pen
tokens.usage: THE pen of the current screen. Components only ever use pen / pen-strong / pen-tint / pen-shadow; data-course="fr" | "en" switches them.

tokens.name: pen-strong
tokens.usage: Hover / pressed of the current pen.

tokens.name: pen-tint
tokens.usage: Tint of the current pen.

tokens.name: pen-shadow
tokens.usage: Print-offset shadow colour of the current pen.

tokens.name: on-pen
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a pen fill (any course).

tokens.name: lamp-300
tokens.usage: Light: lit windows, answered questions, points, focus ring. Text on it is always #142554.

tokens.name: lamp-100
tokens.usage: Streak calendar, a little practice that day (1–19 cards). At night: a dim window.

tokens.name: lamp-500
tokens.usage: Streak calendar, a lot of practice that day (50+ cards). At night: the brightest window.

tokens.name: olive-600
tokens.usage: Richtig: border, icon, text. Always with the check icon.

tokens.name: olive-100
tokens.usage: Richtig: fill.

tokens.name: ochre-600
tokens.usage: Nicht ganz: border, icon, text. Burnt ochre — never red, red is the English pen. Always with the cross icon.

tokens.name: ochre-100
tokens.usage: Nicht ganz: fill.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One poster word per screen, uppercase, in the pen: course card, score screen, masthead.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Score number, course names on cards.

styles.name: word-xl
styles.usage: The word being learned on a vocab card. Soft café-sign serif.

styles.name: word-m
styles.usage: Correct answer in feedback, word chips.

styles.name: hand-l
styles.usage: Feedback verdicts and kickers over a display word. One per view.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Wähle die richtige Form von être.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase pills, progress meta, step numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside pills, between chips and accent keys.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between answer options.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter, compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between blocks in a card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between cards on a screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above the display word on hero screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Street-sign plaques, word chips, accent keys.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Answer options, inputs, hint box.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and pills.

stroke.note: Everything is drawn with one bold pen; UI borders match the illustrations' weight.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Pills, dividers, icons at 24px.

tokens.name: stroke-ui
tokens.usage: Buttons, options, inputs, cards.

tokens.name: stroke-bold
tokens.usage: Selected answer, feedback edge, score ring.

shadow.note: No blur, ever. Raised things get a hard 3px offset in the current pen (3px 3px 0 var(--pen-shadow)), like a misregistered second print plate, and sink into it when pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-print-fr
tokens.usage: Reference value of the French print shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-print-en
tokens.usage: Reference value of the English print shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-print-correct
tokens.usage: Answer in the Richtig state.

tokens.name: shadow-print-wrong
tokens.usage: Answer in the Nicht-ganz state.
